title: Transiting-planet OOD probe
epistemic: NO ground truth. Wrong observable — anomaly/stability only, never accuracy.

tables.name: OOD probe — anomaly vs INARA training distribution

caveats: ⛔ NOT AN ACCURACY TEST. These are wrong-observable inputs for a reflected-light direct-imaging model — any predicted composition is meaningless. The point is to SHOW the inputs are far off-distribution (large anomaly) and/or unstable.
A high anomaly × INARA-median is the expected, desired result: the model correctly sees a transiting spectrum as out-of-distribution.
To probe real files, drop 2–3-column (wavelength_µm, depth/flux[, err]) spectra into data/real_spectra/ (see fetch_benchmarks.py for optional download helpers).
